# 1.0 Purpose:

To establish a standardized and safe maintenance procedure for Compressor maintenance, ensuring the protection of personnel, equipment reliability, and compliance with applicable safety standards.

# 2.0 Scope:

This procedure applies to all maintenance activities involving Compressor maintenance, including inspection, servicing, and replacement tasks. It is intended for use by authorized Mechanical maintenance personnel across all operational areas where Screw Compressor are installed.

# 2.1 Definition and abbreviations:

- SMP: Safe Maintenance Procedure
- LOTOTO: Lock Out Tag Out Try Out
- CCR: Central Control Room ☐ PTW: Permit to Work

# 3.0 Safety, Health & Environment Consideration

To establish a standardized and safe maintenance procedure for Compressor maintenance, ensuring the protection of personnel, equipment reliability, and compliance with applicable safety standards.

This procedure applies to all maintenance activities involving Compressor maintenance, including inspection, servicing, and replacement tasks. It is intended for use by authorized Mechanical maintenance personnel across all operational areas where Screw Compressor are installed.

- SMP: Safe Maintenance Procedure
- LOTOTO: Lock Out Tag Out Try Out

### 3.1 General Safety Rules

- Take general work permit with LOTOTO.
- Ensure Presence of standby person
- Only Authorized & Trained person to perform the job
- Check and verify Isolations.
- Use safe working platforms only
- Provide mechanical LOTO at all energy sources. (Other than Electrical)
- Ensure use tested safety harness
- Ensure use Tested tools, tackles

### 3.2 Health Considerations:

- Ensure person working is Fit & not in fatigue.

### 3.3 Environment Considerations:

- Ensure proper illumination at working area.
- Disposal of waste material like Marking cloth, Empty container of cleaner/CTC etc

### 3.4 Specific Safety Standard requirement:

- Job Plan
- Permit to Work (PTW)
- Material Lifting and lowering
- Machine guarding
- Lock Out Tag Out Try Out (LOTOTO)
- Working at Height

### 3.5 Hazards:

- Dust, fall of material, slip of tools, Failure of lifting tool & tackles, Fall from Height, Fire

### PPE-Matrix

|  During tools, tackles & Material shifting | Safety Helmet | Safety Goggles | Safety shoes | hand gloves | Nose mask, Ear plug,  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  During maintenance | Safety Helmet | Safety Goggles | Safety shoes | Safety harness | hand gloves, Nose mask, Ear plug, Personal lock  |

### 3.6 Environment Control:

- Disposal of waste oil as per waste disposal procedure
- Disposal of cotton waste etc at designated place

### 3.8 Environmental Requirements:

- Proper illumination
- Properly ventilated maintenance space

### 4.0 Quality consideration:

- Tested tools, Instruments / kit to be used for measurement purpose

# 5.0 Maintenance Control and Considerations

• Plan maintenance as per OEM recommendation and condition
• Maintain documents record about maintenance
• Engage competent person on job
• Ensure critical spares availability
• Incorporate site-specific safety measures based on layout, equipment setup, and operational conditions.

# 6.0 Maintenance Procedure

# 6.1 Routine maintenance Procedure-Activities

|  Sn | Activities (Sequence of Work) | Safety Precautions | Responsibility  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  1 | Shifting of spares, tools and tackles | • All tools and tackles are having TPI certificates • Trolley should be in good condition while shifting of tools & tackles • All lifting tools shall be visually inspected before commencing activity. • All lifting tools & tackles shall have identification tag and colour code. | FLE/Fitter  |
|  2 | External Cleaning of Compressor & Dismantling of Machine Guard. | • Ensure LOTOTO of the compressor before start of work • Don't use local made tools for Compressor external cleaning. • Use of tool kit / tool bag. • Use of cotton and soft brush for Compressor External cleaning. • Take material lowering PTW for any lifting activity. • Use tested and colour coded lifting tools and tackles • area to be barricaded • Fire extinguisher is available near work spot | FLE/Fitter  |
|  3 | Checking of Compressor and dismantling of components. | • Ensure LOTOTO of the compressor and apply LPBS before start of work. • Don't use any local made tools for Compressor maintenance activity. | FLE/Fitter  |
